name: gmv_lens
description: Growth / revisions / momentum / participation / value lenses on the all-fields day history. Each lens is the median percentile of its visible parts; lenses are never added. A profile orders names by its weakest lens. Volatility is a denominator and an envelope size, never a lens.

COMPOUNDER.read: Growth that estimates and the tape both confirm. Value is shown, not used.

RERATE.read: Growth with rising estimates that still trades cheap to peers. Momentum is not needed: often early.

BREAKOUT.read: Trend with volume behind it and estimates moving up. A short-term trade, not a valuation call.

VALUE_TURN.read: Cheap names where estimates turn up and buyers return. The rebound case with evidence.

ALL5.read: No weak lens of the five.

FADE.read: Weak trend, falling estimates, and sellers in control together. Short candidates, not an automatic short.
